releaseNotes: Redesigned About Launcher Modal: Clean 2-column layout displaying Author (GAMER ZONE), Developer (NO BI TA), Version (1.3.3), and Game Status (Game Ready) in crisp white, with official copyright notice
Cleaned UI Hover & ToolTips: Eliminated unwanted white OS tooltips on Update Profile, Minimize, and Close buttons, ensuring pure custom dark glass badge visuals
ZIP-Based Profile Sync: High-speed streaming download of 47414d45525a4f4e452050524f.zip with safe local extraction, replacing slow multi-file downloads
Game Mod Exclusion Filtering: Excluded profile archives from automatic mod update scanning to prevent false-positive startup alerts
Close Button System Tray Minimization: Window close ('X') smoothly hides the launcher to the Windows System Tray instead of terminating
Process Force-Kill on Exit: Automatically terminates all active eurotrucks2.exe instances upon explicit exit from tray or sidebar
Telemetry Streaming & Admin Remote Actions: Real-time telemetry reporting (Speed, SteamID64, HWID) and poller for remote administrative actions
Silent Plugin Deployment: Automated deployment of embedded scs-telemetry.dll to the ETS2 plugins directory on launch
